newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania to get oil for $50 mln Iran debt.
newsitem.headline: Romania to get oil for $50 mln Iran debt.

text.p: Romania is to import Iranian oil products to write off Iran's outstanding debts of $50 million, Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu said.

Romanian media quoted Vacaroiu in a weekend statement as saying that Romania had signed an agreement to import 150,000 tonnes of fuel oil and 160,000 tonnes of crude oil to write off the Iranian debt within the next 12 months.
Vacaroiu said the oil would be a welcome addition to the Balkan country's winter energy reserves.
Romania is also to process annually three million tonnes of Iranian crude at its vastly underused refineries, Vacaroiu said.
According to latest statistics, medium and long-term debt to Romania stood at $3.5 billion at the end of last year. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
